mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (to_user_id, from_user_id, type, module, target_id, content) VALUES (#{toUserId}, #{fromUserId}, #{type}, #{module}, #{targetId}, #{content})

INSERT INTO notification (to_user_id, from_user_id, type, module, target_id, content) VALUES
(#{n.toUserId}, #{n.fromUserId}, #{n.type}, #{n.module}, #{n.targetId}, #{n.content})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1 WHERE to_user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT n.*, u.username as from_username, u.avatar as from_avatar FROM notification n JOIN sys_user u ON n.from_user_id = u.id WHERE n.id = #{id}
